name: shuffle-album-mix
title: Album Mix Shuffle
summary: Enables an abandoned Apple feature: Album Shuffle Mix.
description: Settings > Shuffle gets a 4th value, Album Mix. Like Albums, Album Mix plays the albums in a random order. It also shuffles the songs in each album. Apple put this mode in the firmware, but no menu item switched it on.
details: Resored the abandoned Apple feature: Album Mix Shuffle, and fixes bugs in the unfinished code.
Settings > Shuffle: Off, Songs, Albums, Album Mix.
The iPod keeps the setting after a sleep, as the other values.
A change between Albums and Album Mix shuffles the play list again.
notes: This patch needs Shuffle Fixes. Without it, Album Mix repeats some songs and does not play other songs.
The text "Album Mix" is in English for all languages.
Accessories see Album Mix as Albums.

steps: Flash a firmware with this patch and Shuffle Fixes.
Select Shuffle three times. The value is Album Mix.
Select Shuffle Songs in the main menu.
Make sure that the albums and the songs in each album play in a random order.
